about.body1: I’m a Registered Nurse with over 15 years of NHS and private healthcare experience, and the founder of Cottage Aesthetics. Since establishing the clinic, I’ve had the privilege of helping hundreds of clients achieve natural, confidence-boosting results, earning a reputation for personalised, natural treatments where quality, safety, and each client’s individual goals always come first.
about.body2: Throughout my career I've worked within Plastic Surgery, Dermatology and specialist reconstructive services, caring for patients undergoing life-changing procedures. Working alongside highly skilled surgeons has given me an exceptional understanding of skin health, wound healing, facial anatomy, and the importance of precision, symmetry and attention to detail.
about.body3: These environments taught me that every client is unique and the very best outcomes come from understanding the individual in front of you, respecting their natural features and creating results that look balanced, refreshed and authentically *them*. We look forward to welcoming you.
about.title: Hello, I'm Purdi

cottage.body1:
Cottage Aesthetics sits in the peaceful village of Hartlebury, tucked away from the busy high street. 
With a calming Mediterranean feel, every detail is here so you relax from the moment you arrive.
cottage.body2: Complete privacy · Easy and free accessible parking · longer, unhurried appointments · a warm, welcoming atmosphere.
cottage.title: A calm retreat in the Worcestershire countryside

philosophy.body1: Great care extends far beyond the treatment itself. Trust, honesty, safety and communication are at the heart of every positive journey. I believe you should fully understand your options, feel confident in your practitioner, and know you're receiving care based on knowledge, experience and evidence.
philosophy.body2: Enhancing our appearance should never mean fitting into a mould where everyone leaves looking identical. My goal is simply to help you look and feel like the best version of yourself. I never aim to change who you are, but rather enhance what makes you uniquely you. That means longer appointments, honest consultations, individual treatment plans, premium products and genuinely natural-looking results.
philosophy.title: Everyone deserves high-quality care — without inflated prices
